reason: A UI enhancement that adds provider display names to the DeepSeek Harness model selector, but the README states it is deprecated and its functionality has moved to dsh-chat-tweaks.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器显示提供商名称，以便区分不同提供商下的同名模型；该插件已停止维护。
summaries.en: Displays provider names beside model names in the DeepSeek Harness model selector to distinguish identical models from different providers; this plugin is deprecated.

capabilities: Replaces the model selector UI slot
Displays provider names alongside model names
Reuses the host model directory service and existing localization namespace
